Print, tidy and plot latent-class intervention results

latent_methods.Rd

Methods for the results of intervene_within(), intervene_shares(), intervene_latent_sensitivity(), intervene_latent_outcome(), intervene_membership_sensitivity() and intervene_dif(). tidy() returns one row per class (per grid point for the sensitivity curves); autoplot() draws a forest plot of the class-specific effects (class_effects_result, intervention_class_result), the class shares before and after the intervention (class_shares_result) or the sensitivity curve with its confidence band and tipping point (latent_sensitivity_result, lcc_sensitivity_result).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'class_effects_result'
tidy(x, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'class_shares_result'
tidy(x, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'intervention_class_result'
tidy(x, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latent_sensitivity_result'
tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lcc_sensitivity_result'
tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lcc_dif_result'
tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'class_effects_result'
print(x, digits = 3, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'class_shares_result'
print(x, digits = 3, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latent_sensitivity_result'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'intervention_class_result'
print(x, digits = 3, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lcc_subgroup_result'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lcc_sensitivity_result'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lcc_dif_result'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'class_effects_result'
autoplot(object, level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'intervention_class_result'
autoplot(object, level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'class_shares_result'
autoplot(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'latent_sensitivity_result'
autoplot(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lcc_sensitivity_result'
autoplot(object, ...)

Arguments

x, object

A result object.

conf.int

Include confidence limits.

conf.level, level

Confidence level.

...

Ignored.

digits

Digits printed.

Value

print() returns x invisibly; tidy() a data frame; autoplot() a ggplot.
